title: Noticeable Powdered Snow
description: Makes powdered snow easier to detect without making it stand out.
body:
The only purpose of this tiny texturepack is to make powdered snow a little easier to see, without making it stand out but just enough to be noticeable.

## Powdered snow ***with*** this texturepack
